title: $\mathrm{R}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EAL}}\mathrm{G}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{UARD}}$: Reliable, Efficient, and Auditable LLM Safeguards via Latent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.03838v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reasoning-based large language model (LLM) safeguards improve safety classification accuracy by generating explicit rationales before making decisions. However, generating explicit rationales adds substantial decoding overhead to every safety decision, while readable explanations are needed only for on-demand audits. This mismatch motivates $\mathrm{R}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{EAL}}\mathrm{G}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{UARD}}$, a reliable, efficient, and auditable framework for LLM safeguards that decouples safety reasoning from rationale generation via latent reasoning. During training, a task-aligned curriculum progressively replaces explicit rationales with continuous latent reasoning under supervision from the remaining rationale text and final safety labels. In parallel, a lightweight audit decoder is trained to generate explanations conditioned on interaction text and latent states under supervision from condensed task-level rationales. At

translated_title: REALGUARD：通过潜在推理实现可靠、高效且可审计的大语言模型安全防护
translated_abstract: 基于推理的大语言模型（LLM）安全防护通过在做出决策前生成显式的推理依据来提高安全分类的准确性。然而，为每次安全决策生成显式推理依据会增加大量的解码开销，而可读的解释其实仅在按需审计时才需要。这种不匹配促使我们提出了REALGUARD，这是一个可靠、高效且可审计的LLM安全防护框架，它通过潜在推理将安全推理与推理依据生成分离。在训练过程中，任务对齐的课程学习方法在剩余推理文本和最终安全标签的监督下，逐步用连续的潜在推理替换显式推理依据。与此同时，一个轻量级的审计解码器在精简的任务级推理依据的监督下被训练，用于基于交互文本和潜在状态生成解释。
tldr: REALGUARD通过潜在推理将安全推理与解释生成分离，在保持可审计性的同时显著降低了LLM安全防护的解码开销。
en_tdlr: REALGUARD decouples safety reasoning from rationale generation via latent reasoning, significantly reducing decoding overhead for LLM safeguards while preserving auditability.
